reg_deadline.es: El registro cerró el lunes 5 de octubre de 2026.
reg_deadline.quote: Last Day to register to vote Monday October 5, 2026: Register Online by 4pm local time.

mail_request.en: The last day to request a mail-in absentee ballot was Tuesday, October 20, 2026, at 11:59 p.m. Eastern Time.
mail_request.es: El último día para pedir una boleta de voto en ausencia por correo fue el martes 20 de octubre de 2026, a las 11:59 p. m., hora del Este.
mail_request.quote: October 20, 2026, 11:59PM (Eastern Time) – Last day to request a mail-in absentee ballot.
mail_request.en_after: Mail-in ballot requests closed October 20, 2026. You can still vote early in person or at the polls on Election Day.
mail_request.es_after: Las solicitudes de boleta por correo cerraron el 20 de octubre de 2026. Todavía puedes votar por anticipado en persona o en tu lugar de votación el Día de las Elecciones.

mail_return.en: Your county clerk must receive your ballot by 6 p.m. local time on Tuesday, November 3, 2026. A postmark isn't enough, so mail it today or hand it in at your county's drop box.
mail_return.es: La oficina del secretario de tu condado (county clerk) debe recibir tu boleta a más tardar a las 6 p. m., hora local, del martes 3 de noviembre de 2026. El matasellos no basta, así que mándala hoy o entrégala en el buzón de entrega de tu condado.
mail_return.quote: All mail-in absentee ballots must be received by 6:00PM Local Time, on Election Day, November 3, 2026 to be counted.

early_hours.en: Each county sets its own early voting hours. Find yours on GoVoteKY.gov or call your county clerk's office.
early_hours.es: Cada condado fija su propio horario de votación anticipada. Búscalo en el portal oficial para votantes de Kentucky (GoVoteKY.gov) o llama a la oficina del secretario de tu condado (county clerk).
early_hours.quote: Time polls are open during excused, in-person absentee and no-excuse in-person absentee is found on www.govote.ky.gov or contact your County Clerk's office.
early_hours.en_after: Early voting ended October 31. Vote at your polling place on Election Day, 6 a.m. to 6 p.m. local time.
early_hours.es_after: La votación anticipada terminó el 31 de octubre. Vota en tu lugar de votación el Día de las Elecciones, de 6 a. m. a 6 p. m., hora local.

cure.notes: No absentee ballot cure process found on elect.ky.gov or in the SOS 2026 Election Guide.

in_person.en: Registered Kentucky voters can vote early in person Thursday to Saturday, October 29 to 31, no excuse needed. Voters with an approved excuse, such as surgery, the last trimester of pregnancy or a work schedule that covers every voting hour, can also vote in person October 21 to 23 and 26 to 28.
in_person.es: Los votantes registrados en Kentucky pueden votar por anticipado en persona de jueves a sábado, del 29 al 31 de octubre, sin dar una razón. Si tienes una razón aceptada, como una cirugía, el último trimestre de embarazo o un horario de trabajo que cubre todas las horas de votación, también puedes votar en persona del 21 al 23 y del 26 al 28 de octubre.
in_person.quote: In-person, excused absentee voting October 21, 22, 23, and October 26, 27, 28, 2026. ... Early in-person, no excuse absentee voting will take place Thursday, October 29, Friday, October 30, and Saturday, October 31, 2026.
in_person.en_after: Registered Kentucky voters can vote early in person Thursday to Saturday, October 29 to 31, no excuse needed. Hours and places are set by each county.
in_person.es_after: Los votantes registrados en Kentucky pueden votar por anticipado en persona de jueves a sábado, del 29 al 31 de octubre, sin dar una razón. Cada condado fija los horarios y lugares.
in_person.en_after2: Early voting ended Saturday, October 31. On Election Day, polls are open 6 a.m. to 6 p.m. local time.
in_person.es_after2: La votación anticipada terminó el sábado 31 de octubre. El Día de las Elecciones, los lugares de votación abren de 6 a. m. a 6 p. m., hora local.

first_time.en: Registered but never got your confirmation card? Call your county clerk's office to check the status of your registration.
first_time.es: ¿Te registraste pero nunca te llegó tu tarjeta de confirmación? Llama a la oficina del secretario de tu condado (county clerk) para revisar el estado de tu registro.
first_time.quote: Q: I registered to vote, but I did not receive a confirmation card. A: Contact your County Clerk's office to find out the status of your address confirmation.

locator_label.es: Buscador oficial de lugares de votación (Junta Estatal de Elecciones de Kentucky)

rule.en: Find your Election Day polling place, and your county's early voting locations and times, on GoVoteKY.gov.
rule.es: Busca tu lugar de votación del Día de las Elecciones, y los lugares y horarios de votación anticipada de tu condado, en el portal oficial para votantes de Kentucky (GoVoteKY.gov).
rule.quote: To find out when and where early voting will take place in their county, voters should visit the State Board of Elections website at: govote.ky.gov

en: A photo ID with your name from the U.S. government or the Commonwealth of Kentucky
A photo ID with your name from the U.S. Department of Defense, a uniformed service, the Merchant Marine or the Kentucky National Guard
A photo ID with your name from a public or private college, university, or postgraduate technical or professional school in the U.S.
A photo ID with your name from a Kentucky city, county or other local government
es: Una identificación con foto y tu nombre del gobierno de EE. UU. o del estado de Kentucky
Una identificación con foto y tu nombre del Departamento de Defensa de EE. UU., de un servicio uniformado, de la Marina Mercante o de la Guardia Nacional de Kentucky
Una identificación con foto y tu nombre de una universidad pública o privada, o de una escuela técnica o profesional de posgrado en EE. UU.
Una identificación con foto y tu nombre de una ciudad, un condado u otro gobierno local de Kentucky
accepted.quote: "Proof of identification" means a document that was issued by: (a) The United States or the Commonwealth of Kentucky, and the document contains: 1. The name of the individual to whom the document was issued; 2. A photograph of the individual to whom the document was issued;

expired.notes: No rule on expired IDs found on elect.ky.gov or in the SOS 2026 Election Guide.

without.notes: CONFLICT. The SOS 2026 Election Guide (primary-season edition) says voters who cannot get a photo ID 'can sign an Oath (stating reason for inability to obtain photo ID) and present one of the following non-photo IDs: Social Security Card; Any ID issued by a county in KY that’s been approved by the State Board of Elections and shows voter’s name; Any ID card with both the voter’s photograph and name; Any food stamp ID card, electronic benefit transfer card, or supplemental nutrition assistance card issued by KY that shows voter’s name'. KRS 117.228(2), as amended by 2026 Ky. Acts ch. 175 effective July 15, 2026, lists only '(a) Any identification card issued by a county in this state which has the name of the voter stated and has been approved in writing by the State Board of Elections ... or (b) Any identification card with the voter's photograph and the name of the voter stated.'

who.en: Kentucky's mail-in absentee ballot is for voters with a reason. You can get one if you:
who.es: La boleta de voto en ausencia por correo de Kentucky es para votantes con una razón. Puedes pedirla si:
who.quote: Voters are eligible to receive an absentee ballot mailed to the residential address in the county in which they are registered if their completed application is received fourteen (14) days before an election and if the voter is:

en: will be out of your county during all hours of Election Day and all days of in-person absentee voting
can't get to the polls on Election Day or the in-person absentee days because of age, disability or illness
are in the Secretary of State's address confidentiality program for crime victims
are a military or overseas voter
are a student living outside your county for school
are in jail, charged with a crime but not convicted
are living outside Kentucky for now but still eligible to vote here
have a medical emergency, or your spouse does, within 14 days of the election
es: vas a estar fuera de tu condado todas las horas del Día de las Elecciones y todos los días de votación en ausencia en persona
no puedes ir a votar el Día de las Elecciones ni los días de votación en ausencia en persona por tu edad, una discapacidad o una enfermedad
estás en el programa de confidencialidad de domicilio para víctimas de delitos de la Secretaría de Estado
eres votante militar o en el extranjero
eres estudiante y vives fuera de tu condado por la escuela
estás en la cárcel, acusado de un delito pero sin condena
vives fuera de Kentucky por ahora pero todavía puedes votar aquí
tienes una emergencia médica, o tu cónyuge la tiene, dentro de los 14 días antes de la elección
who_list.quote: Not able to appear at the polls on election day or the days excused or no-excuse in-person absentee voting is conducted on the account of age, disability, or illness, and who has not been declared mentally disabled by a court of competent jurisdiction.

witness.notes: No witness rule for mail ballots found. Only the medical emergency application must be notarized (KRS 117.077 on the absentee page).

cure.en: Sign the outer envelope: an unsigned one is rejected automatically. If your signature doesn't match, your county clerk will try to reach you, and you must fix it before polls close on Election Day.
cure.es: Firma el sobre exterior: si no está firmado, se rechaza automáticamente. Si tu firma no coincide, la oficina del secretario de tu condado tratará de contactarte, y debes corregirlo antes de que cierre la votación el Día de las Elecciones.
cure.quote: All signature cures shall be completed before the closing of the polls on the day of a primary or an election;

dropbox.en: Every county has a drop box where you can hand deliver your ballot. Find yours on the State Board of Elections site, and don't wait until Election Day.
dropbox.es: Cada condado tiene un buzón de entrega donde puedes dejar tu boleta en persona. Busca el tuyo en el sitio de la Junta Estatal de Elecciones, y no esperes al Día de las Elecciones.
dropbox.quote: Drop boxes are available in each county to hand deliver your ballot. To find out where the drop box is in your county, voters should visit the State Board of Elections website at: elect.ky.gov

gear.en: No campaigning at the polling place or within 100 feet of an entrance voters use. That covers campaign signs, handing out literature and asking for votes. A bumper sticker on your parked car is fine, and inside the voting room, don't talk about who you support.
gear.es: No se permite hacer campaña en el lugar de votación ni a menos de 100 pies de una entrada que usen los votantes. Eso incluye letreros de campaña, repartir propaganda y pedir votos. Una calcomanía en la defensa de tu carro estacionado sí se permite, y dentro del cuarto de votación no hables de a quién apoyas.
gear.quote: Electioneering shall include the displaying of signs, the distribution of campaign literature, cards, or handbills, the soliciting of signatures to any petition, or the solicitation of votes for or against any bona fide candidate or ballot question in a manner which expressly advocates the election or defeat of the candidate or expressly advocates the passage or defeat of the ballot question, but shall not include exit polling, bumper stickers affixed to a person's vehicle while parked within or passing through a distance of one hundred (100) feet of any entrance to a building in which voting is conducted

phone.en: Kentucky lets you photograph yourself and your own ballot in the voting room. Don't photograph other voters, and don't use the picture to campaign within 100 feet of an entrance voters use.
phone.es: En Kentucky puedes tomarte una foto a ti y a tu propia boleta en la sala de votación. No les tomes fotos a otros votantes, y no uses la foto para hacer campaña a menos de 100 pies de una entrada que usen los votantes.
phone.quote: Electioneering shall not include: ... A voter's use of a personal telecommunications device ... in the voting room to record or transmit electronically an image of his or her own personal likeness and ballot, if the voter does not use the picture: (a) To solicit ... votes ... and (b) Within a distance of 100 feet of any entrance to a building in which a voting machine is located if that entrance is: 1. Unlocked; and 2. Used by voters on election day. (31 KAR 4:170, eff. 5-5-2026)

line.en: If you're in line at 6 p.m., you'll be allowed to vote.
line.es: Si estás en la fila a las 6 p. m., te dejarán votar.
line.quote: Polls are open from 6:00 AM to 6:00 PM local time on Tuesday, November 3rd , 2026. If you are in line at 6:00 PM, you will be allowed to vote.

tradition.en: Kentucky's 2026 I voted sticker is a smiling sun over rolling Kentucky pasture with a blue outline of the state, drawn by Ryker, a student at Bush Elementary in Laurel County. Voters picked it from the finalists with more than 3,500 ballots at the Kentucky State Fair. Laurel County gets the stickers from the Secretary of State's Office, and other county clerks can request them for November, so not every polling place will have one.
tradition.es: El sticker "I Voted" de Kentucky para 2026 es un sol sonriente sobre los pastizales de Kentucky con el contorno del estado en azul. Lo dibujó Ryker, estudiante de la escuela primaria Bush en el condado de Laurel. Los votantes lo eligieron entre los finalistas con más de 3,500 votos en la Feria Estatal de Kentucky. El condado de Laurel recibe los stickers de la Secretaría de Estado, y los secretarios de otros condados pueden pedirlos para noviembre, así que no todos los lugares de votación los tendrán.
tradition.quote: Laurel County will receive "I Voted" stickers featuring Ryker's design from the Secretary of State's Office. Other county clerks may request the stickers to provide to voters during the November election.

provisional.en: You can vote a provisional ballot if your name isn't on the precinct roster and the precinct officer can't confirm your registration, or if you don't have ID. Afterward, use the State Board of Elections' Provisional Voter Information link to see whether it was counted.
provisional.es: Puedes votar con una boleta provisional si tu nombre no está en la lista del precinto y el funcionario del precinto no puede confirmar tu registro, o si no tienes identificación. Después, usa el enlace Provisional Voter Information de la Junta Estatal de Elecciones para ver si se contó.
provisional.quote: Vote a provisional ballot if: Voter name does not appear on the precinct roster and whose registration status cannot be determined by the precinct officer Voter name does not appear on the precinct roster and who has been verified as ineligible to vote Voter does not have identification ... Provisional Voter Information link to determine if your provisional ballot was counted or not counted
provisional.notes: Pass 2 Oct 30, read by curl. The 2026 officer guide says a provisional ballot covers federal offices only (Perplexity lead, not read; left out). Replaces: If there's a problem at your polling place, you can vote a provisional ballot.

line.en: You can still vote. If you're in line at 6 p.m. local time, you'll be allowed to vote.
line.es: Todavía puedes votar. Si estás en la fila a las 6 p. m., hora local, te dejarán votar.
line.quote: If you are in line at 6:00 PM, you will be allowed to vote.

track.en: Check your absentee ballot status on GoVoteKY.gov.
track.es: Revisa el estado de tu boleta de voto en ausencia en el portal oficial para votantes de Kentucky (GoVoteKY.gov).
track.quote: Review Your Registration or Absentee Ballot Status

late_mail.en: It may be. Your county clerk must receive it by 6 p.m. local time on Tuesday, November 3, and a postmark doesn't count. Instead, hand it in at your county's drop box or your county clerk's office as soon as you can, and don't wait until Election Day.
late_mail.es: Puede que sí. El secretario de tu condado (county clerk) debe recibirla a más tardar a las 6 p. m., hora local, del martes 3 de noviembre, y el matasellos no cuenta. Mejor entrégala lo antes posible en el buzón de entrega de tu condado o en la oficina del secretario del condado, sin esperar al Día de las Elecciones.
late_mail.quote: Voters are highly encouraged not to wait until Election Day to hand deliver their absentee ballot. Cast your ballot as soon as you receive it. Do not delay! Drop boxes are available in each county to hand deliver your ballot.
late_mail.notes: Pass 2 Oct 30, read by curl. 6 p.m. receipt: dates.mail_return (same page, Oct 21).

notes: Read October 21, 2026. elect.ky.gov returned intermittent 504s and govote.ky.gov blocks curl as a bot; pages were read with curl on retry and in Chrome (govote.ky.gov redirects to vrsws.sos.ky.gov/ovrweb/govoteky/). Read: elect.ky.gov 2026 General Election Summary, Voter ID Requirements, Eligibility for Absentee Voting, Election Day FAQ; the SOS 2026 Kentucky Election Guide PDF (its dates are for the May primary, so only its general rules are used); the SOS I Voted Sticker Contest page; KRS 117.228 and 117.235 on apps.legislature.ky.gov. The SBE 2026 Election Calendar PDF returned 504. EARLY VOTING DATES FOR THE LEAD (states.js has KY unchecked): no-excuse in-person early voting Thursday, October 29, Friday, October 30, and Saturday, October 31, 2026; hours set by each county. Source https://elect.ky.gov/Voters/Pages/Voting-In-Person-and-By-Mail.aspx: 'Early in-person, no excuse absentee voting will take place Thursday, October 29, Friday, October 30, and Saturday, October 31, 2026.' and 'In-Person, No Excuse Absentee "Early" Voting October 29, 30, & 31, 2026'. Suggested states.js note: 'Hours vary by county. Check GoVoteKY.gov.' CONFLICT on excused in-person absentee days (left out of the file): the same summary page says 'In-person, excused absentee voting October 21, 22, 23, and October 26, 27, 28, 2026.' and 'October 21, 22, 23, 26, 27, & 28, 2026 (ONLY)', but the Election Day FAQ says 'excused in-person Wednesday – Friday, October 21 - October 23, 2026 and Monday – Wednesday, October 29 - October 31, 2026' (October 29 to 31 is Thursday to Saturday, the no-excuse days). The absentee page's rule ('the six (6) business days immediately before the last Thursday occurring before election day') matches October 21 to 23 and 26 to 28. CONFLICT on voting without photo ID (id.without left missing; quotes in its notes): the SOS guide's non-photo list (Social Security card, SNAP/EBT card) is not in KRS 117.228 as amended effective July 15, 2026. The faq_text.py KY id answer ('If you can't get one, you can sign an affirmation and vote') leaves out that the statute now also requires a county ID approved by the SBE or a card with the voter's photo and name; the lead may want to review it. Phone fact rests on a parenthetical in the SOS guide; no statute on ballot photos was read. Expired-ID rule, witness rule, cure and the general provisional-ballot rules were not found.

hours.en: Polling places are open 6 a.m. to 6 p.m. local time.
hours.es: Los lugares de votación abren de 6 a. m. a 6 p. m., hora local.
hours.quote: Polls are open from 6:00 AM to 6:00 PM local time on Tuesday, November 3rd, 2026.
